description: List the chat apps a hub can answer in (GET /v1/bridges/connectors): Telegram and Discord, and Matrix, Mattermost or Twitch when they are listed. Each has status (offered, or beta), offered (whether a bridge can be created for it now), its description and setup steps in the language asked (English where there is no French), the secrets the console asks for (key, label, required: names only, never a value), the settings form, what a chat id looks like (targets: label, pattern, max, lowercase, strip_prefix), require_mention_fixed, the session scopes, and its helpers: with discover, thalovant_list_bridge_chats lists the chats (otherwise ids are typed); with test_message, thalovant_send_bridge_test_message works. Creating a bridge, and pasting or replacing its token or secrets, happen only in the Thalovant console (Connections > Add connection > Chat apps, or the hub's Chat apps tab): no tool takes a token or secret. Requires the hubs:read scope. Reads only.

apiUrl.description: Control-plane base URL. Configured credentials may only be used on their configured origin; defaults to https://api.thalovant.com.

language.description: Language for descriptions, setup steps and labels: en or fr. French falls back to English where a text has no French.

loginScope.description: Optional login scope used with THALOVANT_EMAIL and THALOVANT_PASSWORD.
